shortDescription: Shared ability AI for NPC pawns plus player autocast, split out of Entad Framework. Entad and Bastle Framework use it as a soft dependency through gated compat assemblies; without it they fall back to vanilla's simple casting.
body:
## What it is
The ability AI that used to live in Entad Framework (`Source/AbilityAI/`), now its own mod so Entad Framework and Bastle Framework share one copy. Namespace `AbilityAI`, keyed prefix `AAI_`, Harmony id `saintwacko.abilityai`. Builds 1.6 and 1.7 (LoadFolders, shared `Source/`, per-version csproj under `1.6/Source` and `1.7/Source`, `Source/AbilityAI.Build.csproj` builds both). Krafs refs; Harmony is the only hard dependency.

## How abilities opt in
An `AbilityAIExtension` on the AbilityDef naming a worker class (AoEHostile, AoEFriendly, SelfBuff, Movement, Cover, Recovery, TargetHostile, TargetFriendly, Defensive, Rescue, Calm, Interrupt, Firefighting). Several extensions per ability are allowed and are tried by priority. Each worker has a combat mode (InCombat default; Recovery OutOfCombat; Rescue, Calm, Firefighting Any), overridable per extension with `combat`. Royalty's combat psycasts get extensions from `Patches/AbilityAI_Royalty.xml`: FindMod Royalty, then one PatchOperationConditional per def so a missing psycast only loses its own rule.

## Who casts
- Driver: a postfix on `Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob`, at most once per 30 ticks per pawn, plus a global minimum gap between casts.
- NPCs (hostile, non-hostile, animals, mechs; each toggleable): cast abilities a host hook claims, or any ability with an extension when "Also use abilities no mod claims" is on. Factionless casters (manhunters, wild animals) build their enemy list from every spawned pawn hostile to them plus whoever they are fighting back against, since the attack-target cache gives them nothing.
- Player pawns: only abilities set to autocast from a right-click on the gizmo (saved in a WorldComponent; works on shrunk gizmos too via Command.GizmoOnGUIShrunk). Drafted: any worker, only while holding position or shooting, never mid-move. Undrafted (setting "Also while undrafted", default on): only workers that aren't combat-only (`WorksUndrafted`), never while lying down, carrying, on a player-forced job, or on a job with casualInterruptible false (bills, surgery). The interrupted job is not resumed; the pawn picks work again. Pawns with no drafter (most animals) get the menu only for abilities with an undrafted-capable worker. Player pawns in a mental break act as NPCs only with BreakCasting on.
- Approach: ranged NPCs walk into range for abilities with `approachDistance`. Player pawns never walk to cast.
- AoEFriendly targeted casts try up to 5 allies, most covered first, so one out-of-sight ally doesn't block the cast.

## Host API (soft-dependency contract)
Hosts must keep all references to this assembly in a compat DLL loaded via `IfModActive="saintwacko.AbilityAI"`. A type in the host's main DLL that implements our interface would make RimWorld drop the whole host DLL when this mod is missing.
- `AbilityAIHooks.Register(IAbilityAIHook)`: Vote Claim/Veto/NoOpinion per pawn+ability, and Notify_AICast.
- `AbilityAIInfo.Register<T>(radius, hediff, stuns)`: describes a host's own effect comp to the workers (replaces implementing `IAbilityAIInfo`, which still works for hard dependents). Cached per comp-properties object; registering clears this cache and the workers' per-def effects cache.
- `AbilityAIDriver.Handles(pawn, ability)`: whether this mod is deciding for that pair.

## Vanilla stand-down
Hosts keep `aiCanUse` on so their abilities still get vanilla's simple casting without this mod. A postfix on `Ability.AICanTargetNow` returns false whenever `Handles` is true (setting "Replace vanilla's casting", default on), so vanilla's fight AI and Bastle's own JobGiver skip abilities this mod is handling. For player pawns Handles is true only when the driver could actually cast (drafted, or undrafted with an undrafted-capable worker).

## Settings
Own settings page (`AbilityAIMod`): enabled, per pawn kind, unclaimed, vanilla stand-down, approach, player autocast, also while undrafted, break casting, min gap slider, dev debug log, reset.

## Autocast badge
Full-size gizmo: second text line on the left (below the hotkey/cooldown line, above the label). Shrunk gizmo: bottom left. Width clamped and text truncated to the button.

## Handoffs
`.circinus/handoff/entad-framework.md` and `.circinus/handoff/bastle-framework.md`: step lists for each host's agent (remove moved code, gated compat assembly, extensions moved into gated patches, loadAfter only).
